title: Section normalization of ordinary native direct evaluation
statement: For a prime $l$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_l$, and the positive coefficient system $A_n=\mathcal O_E/\mathfrak m_E^{n+1}$, let $g:Z\to Y$ be any scheme morphism. Compose the native ordinary module evaluation comparison moduleEvalP [def-sp-varying-ring-operations] with compactSupportDirectModel [def-weil-compact-support-native-system-evaluation], obtaining $c_n:g_*^{\mathrm{sys}};e_n^Y\cong e_n^Z;g_*^{A_n}$. For every coefficient-system module $M$, pro-etale object $V$ on $Y$, and section $x$ of $e_n^Y(g_*^{\mathrm{sys}}M)$ on $V$, the section $(c_{n,M})_V(x)$ is heterogeneously equal to $x$ under the unchanged underlying section carriers. This also specifies the real construction compactSupportOrdinaryDirectEvaluation of $c_n$.

source.place: Tags 03DI and 0D6E; section formula for ordinary direct-image evaluation.

proof.text: The unique normalization defining moduleEvalP states that its underlying section map is identity. compactSupportDirectModel is constructed with identity underlying section maps. Unfold the composite only far enough to see the latter identity, and apply the normalization of moduleEvalP. The resulting equality is stated heterogeneously to retain the two named module structures on the same section carrier.

theorem compactSupportOrdinaryDirectEvaluation_sections {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Z ⟶ Y)
    (n : ℕ) (M : coefficientSequenceModules.{u, u} l E Z) (V : Y.ProEtᵒᵖ)
    (x : ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y n).obj
      ((ProEtale.VaryingRing.push (compactSupportSystemLevel l E)
        (compactSupportSystemQuotient l E) g).obj M)).val.obj V) :
    HEq (((compactSupportOrdinaryDirectEvaluation l E g n).hom.app M).val.app V x) x
